title: World Bosses
content: World bosses spawn in the open world and anyone can attack them: Doom Lord Kazzak roams Hellfire Peninsula, Doomwalker walks Shadowmoon Valley, and Azuregos, a blue dragon, guards Azshara. They need a raid-sized group and respawn on long timers.

title: Rare Elite Creatures
content: Rare monsters show a silver dragon on their portrait and spawn rarely at fixed spots; elites have a gold dragon and need a group. Killing every Northrend rare earns the Frostbitten achievement, and the most hunted is the Time-Lost Proto-Drake in the Storm Peaks, which drops its own mount.

title: Class and Profession Trainers
content: Class trainers stand in the capitals and in each starting zone's main town, and teach new spells and ranks for gold, with new ones every two levels. Profession trainers are in the capitals too, and the Grand Master ranks for Northrend (skill 350 to 450) are taught in Dalaran. Class trainers also reset talents and sell dual spec at 40.

title: Special Vendors
content: Reputation quartermasters sell recipes, enchants and gear as your standing rises: the Kirin Tor's is Archmage Alvareaux in Dalaran, the Sons of Hodir's is Lillehoff at Dun Niffelem in the Storm Peaks, and the Wyrmrest Accord's is Cielstrasza at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

title: Flight Masters
content: Speak to a flight master once to learn that flight path; after that you can fly between any paths you know for a fee that grows with distance. Alliance ride gryphons and hippogryphs, Horde ride wyverns, bats and dragonhawks, and Northrend's flight masters serve both factions in places like Dalaran.

title: Innkeepers and Hearthstones
content: Speak to any innkeeper and make the inn your home to bind your Hearthstone there; the Hearthstone then brings you back to that inn on a 30-minute cooldown. Logging out in an inn or a capital builds rested experience, and innkeepers also sell food and drink.

title: Bankers and Guild Banks
content: Bankers in every capital and in Dalaran hold your personal bank: 28 slots plus seven bag slots bought with gold. A guild bank, opened at a guild vault, has up to six tabs of 98 slots, bought with gold, and the guild leader sets who can withdraw from each.

title: Stable Masters
content: Stable masters hold a hunter's tamed beasts, letting one hunter keep several pets and swap between them. They do nothing for mounts, which live in the spellbook once learned. Stables are found in most towns and every capital. Swapping at a stable is how a hunter changes to a pet better suited to the fight ahead.

title: Important Lore Figures
content: Wrath's story centers on Arthas Menethil, the Lich King, waiting on the Frozen Throne atop Icecrown Citadel. Along the way players face Malygos, the blue Dragon Aspect, in the Eye of Eternity and the Old God Yogg-Saron beneath Ulduar, while Tirion Fordring leads the Argent Crusade and Darion Mograine the Knights of the Ebon Blade.

title: Faction Leaders
content: Alliance leaders: King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind, King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge, High Tinker Mekkatorque for the gnomes, Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus and Prophet Velen in the Exodar. Horde leaders: Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar, Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff, Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity, Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon and Vol'jin of the Darkspear trolls.

title: Specialized Merchants
content: General goods vendors sell food, drink and bags, and reagent vendors carry class reagents. Rogues buy poisons from poison vendors and hunters buy arrows and bullets from ammo vendors. Armorers and weaponsmiths repair your gear, and any vendor buys your loot.

title: City Guards and Sentries
content: Guards in capitals and towns attack enemy-faction players who are flagged and hostile creatures that wander in. Ask any guard for directions and it marks the nearest bank, inn, trainer, flight master or auction house on your minimap.

title: Transportation NPCs
content: Boats and zeppelins are free. To Northrend, Alliance sail from Stormwind Harbor to Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra or from Menethil Harbor to Valgarde in Howling Fjord; Horde fly from Orgrimmar to Warsong Hold or from the Undercity to Vengeance Landing. The neutral Booty Bay-Ratchet boat links the old continents, and Shattrath has portals to your faction's capitals.
